# frostmoln_appgw_waf_exclusion (Resource)

Narrows a WAF rule so it stops matching a request shape you know is good — a field that legitimately contains SQL, an upload endpoint, an API that posts XML.

Like a rule, an exclusion lands on the policy's **draft** and takes effect only when it is published and the gateway applies its configuration.

Target exactly one of `target_secrule_id` or `target_tag`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Prefer an exclusion over disabling a rule: it narrows the rule to stop
# matching one known-good field on one path, rather than turning it off
# everywhere.

resource "frostmoln_appgw_waf_exclusion" "search_query" {
  gateway_id = frostmoln_application_gateway.edge.id
  policy_id  = frostmoln_appgw_waf_policy.main.id
  rule_key   = "allow-sql-in-search-q"

  target_secrule_id = 942100

  variable     = "ARGS"
  selector     = "q"
  path_pattern = "^/search"

  description = "The search box accepts free text that trips the SQLi rules."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `gateway_id` (String) The Application Gateway the policy belongs to.
- `policy_id` (String) The WAF policy this exclusion belongs to.
- `rule_key` (String) Your stable name for this exclusion: 1-64 lowercase letters, digits or hyphens, starting and ending with a letter or digit.
- `variable` (String) The variable to exclude from inspection, e.g. `ARGS` or `REQUEST_HEADERS`.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Why this exclusion exists. At most 1024 characters.

Worth filling in: an exclusion is a hole in your firewall, and the next person reviewing it needs to know whether it is still justified.
- `ordinal` (Number) Evaluation order within the policy.
- `path_pattern` (String) Limit the exclusion to matching request paths, so it applies where the false positive is rather than everywhere. At most 1024 characters.
- `selector` (String) A specific field within the variable, e.g. a parameter or header name. Omit to exclude the whole variable, which is much broader — prefer naming the one field that is a false positive.
- `target_secrule_id` (Number) The single managed rule to narrow, by its SecRule id.
- `target_tag` (String) The tag whose rules to narrow, e.g. `attack-sqli`. At most 128 characters.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The creation timestamp.
- `revision` (Number) A server-assigned counter, bumped on every write. Feed it into `frostmoln_appgw_waf_policy_publication.rule_revisions` so a publish is ordered after this exclusion without `depends_on`.
- `updated_at` (String) The last update timestamp.
